summary: Regression of 3 fixes. PASS: (a) admin login with admin@pranvithdop.com / Admin123! now returns access_token; (b) Login/Register no longer emit React setState-in-render warnings (useEffect fix verified); (c) /api/products still returns the correct 8 slugs and /api/auth/login works for the existing test user. FAIL (partial): the 'PranavithDOP' (extra 'a') typo is STILL rendered on / (Home) and /about because the rebrand only refreshes the 'home' page doc and SETTINGS — the FAQs and the about/works/hire/contact CMS pages stored in MongoDB are stale and the seed logic for those collections is gated on count==0 / only contains a 'home' entry, so the rebrand never propagates to them.

minor.issue: Returns legacy 'PranavithDOP' (extra 'a') in 2 FAQ docs. seed_data.FAQS has the correct brand 'PranvithDOP' but server.py seeds FAQs only when db.faqs.count_documents({}) == 0, so the rebrand never overwrites existing rows.

Stale CMS docs still contain 'PranavithDOP' (about=3, works=2, hire=2, contact=1 occurrences). The new upsert seed only re-applies the 'home' page because seed_data.PAGES contains a single 'home' entry; the other pages were created by an earlier seed run and are never refreshed.

design_issues.screen: / (Home FAQ section) and /about (intro paragraph + footer SEO)
issues: Home page renders 'PranavithDOP' (extra 'a') 2x inside the FAQ block ('Why should I pay to join PranavithDOP?' and 'YouTube tutorials are scattered ... PranavithDOP provides ...').
About page renders 'From beginner to paid editor. PranavithDOP blends professional editing workflows...' (1 instance with extra 'a').
Header, footer, hero title, and site_name now correctly show 'PranvithDOP' — only the DB-stored CMS/FAQ text is stale.

action_items: Refresh stale CMS docs. Two clean options: (1) one-off migration in server.startup that does db.faqs.update_many({'q': {'$regex': 'PranavithDOP'}}, ...) and same for db.pages — or, simpler, db.faqs.delete_many({}) followed by re-insert from FAQS on every boot (or whenever a SEED_FORCE_REFRESH env flag is set); (2) Make the FAQ seed an upsert keyed on the FAQ question (mirror the pages upsert) and add the missing 'about'/'works'/'hire'/'contact' entries to seed_data.PAGES so the upsert path overwrites them on next boot.

Quickest verifiable fix: run a one-time string-replace migration at startup, e.g. for each collection in (faqs, pages): find docs containing 'PranavithDOP' and update them by replacing with 'PranvithDOP'. This is cheap, idempotent, and clears the legacy data without touching seed_data.py.
After fix, re-run /api/faqs and /api/pages/{about,works,hire,contact} and confirm 0 occurrences of the bad string.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py FAQ seed (line ~1151) uses `if count == 0` guard — this same anti-pattern from the previous iteration is what caused the admin-login regression; it now repeats for FAQs. Recommend switching all default seed paths to upsert-by-natural-key for consistency.
seed_data.PAGES is missing about/works/hire/contact entries even though those slugs are served by the frontend — DB content for those pages is effectively un-version-controlled.
seed_default_admin (server.py ~945) — fix verified working (deletes stale emails + upserts the env admin).

success_rate.frontend: 75% (admin login + login/register console clean; brand typo still visible on Home + About)

test_credentials: Admin admin@pranvithdop.com / Admin123! WORKS. Customer test@pranvithdop.com / Test1234! WORKS.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run still creates a throwaway e2e-<ts>@pranvithdop.com user via /api/auth/register. No teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_customer_funnel.py (TestProducts + TestAuth fully green this run incl. test_admin_login). To re-verify the brand fix after main agent's next change, just curl: (1) `curl $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/faqs | grep -c PranavithDOP` should print 0, (2) `curl $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/pages/about | grep -c PranavithDOP` should print 0, and (3) reload / and /about in the browser and grep page HTML for 'PranavithDOP' — must be 0. The brand typo to detect is 'Pran-a-vithDOP' (extra 'a' before 'v'); 'Pranavith' as a person's first name in founder copy is correct and intentional.
rca_of_the_issue: Symptom: legacy 'PranavithDOP' (extra 'a') still rendered on / and /about. Reproduction: GET /api/faqs returns 2 docs with 'PranavithDOP'; GET /api/pages/about returns 3. Root cause: the rebrand fix only updated (a) seed_data.SETTINGS (upserted on boot, works), (b) seed_data.PAGES['home'] (upserted on boot, works), and (c) seed_default_admin (now upserts, works). It did NOT touch the FAQs collection (seeded behind a count==0 guard) or the about/works/hire/contact page docs (not present in PAGES at all). Those docs were written by a prior seed run that contained the typo and are now effectively frozen. Mitigation: convert the FAQ seed to upsert-by-question + add missing slugs to PAGES, OR run a one-shot string-replace migration on db.faqs and db.pages at startup.
